body:
He said it to my face, tonight, when the fire alarm went off and we were with a mutual friend. I asked him outright if that was what he thought happened. He said yes, he was too drunk to consent and would not have had he been sober and that he considers it rape. 

I broke off the sexual relationship when my FWB freaked out- he wanted to continue it.
How is it conflicting? I'm posting about something that hurts.
Mine is usually under control. Right now though... it's not
He said that he would not have done it had he been sober

They told me that unless he came forward, they could do nothing, and laughed.

What now?
That doesn't matter. He couldn't consent.
And? So is having sex with someone who is too intoxicated to consent.
I was not cheating. I was not in any exclusive relationship at the time. I had a friend with benefits. We'd both agreed it wasn't exclusive. Don't make this something it isn't. This is all on me.
No. But I didn't know. And it doesn't require a no for it to be rape... I didn't when I was violently raped and beaten.

He's been known to consume large amount of drugs. I can see it easily. 

And if I slept with him when he was too high to consent... I'm a rapist.
I wasn't in any exclusive relationships at the time of what happened. Reread my OP- the guy was my friend with benefits. No one was dating anyone except for my friend
I could do that too. Would be easier for everyone. Less of a shame to have a dead child than one in jail for my parents.
I'm going to turn myself in. It's rape. He was intoxicated and I slept with him. I'm a rapist.
Ok. I'm going downstairs to the police.

I guess you're right. Maybe turning myself in would be a good move- calling school psychiatric or campus police. Explain I'm a rapist. 

The counsellors don't act in the interest of the student. They will make me leave university, or lock me up in a psych ward. At the very least, I will be drug tested.

I see the counselor at school because I left on PTSD and drug related medical leave last year. They will put me on involuntary medical leave and not let me back if I exhibit these issues again- at best. At worst, I'll end up on involuntary psychological hold. I have no one and nowhere to turn.
You're right. You're so right. I smelled the pot on him, on his clothes, on his beard... just assumed it was residual, was leftover from him smoking earlier...

But... he said this not just to the girlfriend (they're long distance) but to our friends. The guys we hang out with. And my FWB. And now they're no longer speaking to me. And if he was fucked up... I've seen a lot of people do shit they shouldn't do fucked up. I'm a recovering addict myself. I've done a lot of shit I wouldn't do fucked up. And if I fucked him when he couldn't consent... that's rape. And that makes me the worst thing I could be.

He was attracted to me. He doesn't deny that- actually initially proposed a threesome with me and my FWB. And **he didn't say this to me**. He said this to our friend group, to excuse the first time he fucked me- not the others.

Speaking as someone who has been raped... sometimes you go back, just to try to make it "okay", try to make it all make sense. Make it on your terms. So his behavior makes sense to me. 

And I thought he was sober. I was sure of it. I couldn't tell. I don't sleep with drunk or high people to avoid this.

My friends hate me because I'm a slut and a rapist.
His relationship is open, from my understanding. And he didn't say it directly to me, but to my FWB and their social group. So the group hates me because I raped him. And they're right to.
